data.name: METROLOGY
data.detailed_description:
METROLOGY is a First Person Horror set in the dark depths of the Underground Metro Transit System.

Traverse endless tunnels while the horrors of the Underground haunt you. Uncover secrets, solve environmental puzzles and RUN. You do not want to be here. THEY do not want you here. Escape, if you can…

Welcome to the Underground Metro Transit System

You’ve been commuting here for years. But this time it's different. On this auspicious day turned bleak, something pulled you in. You wake up beneath the publicly accessible Metro platforms, you must find a way out. Meanwhile something beckons you from the darkness, it watches you. Its secrets desiring to be found.

Prove your worth

Sneak around dark and abandoned sites full of death. Don't let the ghosts and monsters that roam the Underground hear or see you if you value your life. And if you are spotted you better run or prepare yourself to join the dead.

Solve environmental puzzles using any tools you can find to make your way through the Underground as you seek an exit.

Seek and Find

Explore Metro tunnels, murky sewers, abandoned maintenance tunnels, humming generator rooms and more.

You must find a way out and escape the dreaded madness of the deep.

No longer just a traveller, you have to become a survivor.

Survive... METROLOGY.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0
  • Processor: Intel® Core™i3 / Apple M1 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes horror scenes of dead bodies, monsters and blood.
